newsitem.title: INDIA: At least five dead in Kashmir blasts - news agency.
newsitem.headline: At least five dead in Kashmir blasts - news agency.

text.p: At least five people died and several were injured on Saturday in two explosions at the central bus station in Jammu, the winter capital of India's Jammu and Kashmir state, the United News of India (UNI) news agency said.
UNI said a powerful bomb placed on a bicycle exploded at about 6.40 p.m. (1310 GMT) near an empty bus parked at the bus station. Five passersby were killed by the blast, the agency said.
It said a second bomb exploded a few minutes later.
The blasts occurred on the second day of crucial talks between senior Indian and Pakistani diplomats in New Delhi, the first in three years between the bitter rivals.

The last round of talks in January 1994 collapsed over Kashmir, where a separatist Moslem revolt has been raging since 1980 in the part of the Himalayan territory controlled by India. Pakistan rules one-third of the Kashmir valley and India the rest.
